title.en: Living together with people and nature

text.en: Sometimes birds, insects and animals come into our home without being invited. How do we feel about them?

We bring some animals and plants into our homes and some just start living there.
Sometimes we share our home happily, but sometimes we do not like them.
Which are the uninvited animals, birds and insects at your home? Why do you think they come?
The teacher's note says we must not hurt animals even if we do not like them or are scared of them.
Animals do not hurt us unless they feel threatened.
Ask elders which animals and plants they kept when they were young, and listen to their stories.

text.en: Ask an elder to help it out.
